title: PAH-OMC-020 N2b parsed-owner-provenance false-positive correction
question: Does the current-byte N2b independent audit identify an admitted owner packet from parsed provenance fields rather than authorization prose inside contract documents?
method: Run the current N2b independent replay against the exact worktree inventory and isolate the three owner-search contract paths reported as strict candidates.
Inspect the candidate JSON and confirm that source_authorized_packet_present=true occurred only in marker-policy prose, while the actual snapshot value is false.

Change only the independent candidate predicate to parse JSON booleans in the packet/provenance/snapshot/current_status sections; do not change PAH-001, the owner predicate, the finite model or the scientific scope.
Regenerate and replay the primary, non-importing independent, hostile and integrated N2b lanes with the canonical pinned Lean package cache.
finding: The previous independent failure was a verifier false-positive, not evidence of an owner packet: contract prose containing the literal marker source_authorized_packet_present=true was mistaken for a true provenance field. After parsed-boolean admission, the strict candidate set is empty and primary 22/22, independent 16/16, hostile 12/12, integrated 22/22 and six finite Lean declarations pass.
decision_reason: This is an append-only reproducibility correction. It restores the intended owner-admission predicate and leaves the scientific result at HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE; no source-authorized U_n/common-space packet is admitted.
boundary: Immutable PAH-001, original OMC-013/017/018/019 chain, labelled Gibbs state, original rates, external stochastic Markov time and j-before-anchored-n order are unchanged. No comparison map, carrier, rate, state, counterterm, limit or physical interpretation is added.
